d: Company Description QD Industries is a sustainability-focused organization dedicated to transforming waste into valuable resources through advanced recycling practices. The company promotes eco-friendly operations and continuously seeks innovative ways to reduce environmental impact. QD Industries’ work supports a circular economy, turning discarded materials into usable products while minimizing landfill usage. Team members contribute directly to meaningful environmental outcomes and work in a culture that values responsibility, innovation, and long-term sustainability.

Role Description The Import and Export Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Mesaieed. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end import and export processes, including preparing and reviewing shipping documentation, coordinating with freight forwarders, customs agents, and regulatory authorities, and ensuring compliance with international trade regulations. The specialist will monitor shipments, track delivery timelines, and resolve any logistical or documentation issues to maintain smooth material flows. Daily tasks include communicating with customers and suppliers, updating internal systems with accurate shipment information, and collaborating with operations and finance teams to support cost-effective, timely international movements of recycled materials and related products.
q: li
Strong knowledge of import and export procedures and regulations, including practical experience in Import, Export, and Import Export activities.
li
Understanding of International Trade practices, trade compliance, and documentation requirements for cross-border shipments.
li
Proficient customer service skills with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams, suppliers, and clients.
li
Experience working with logistics providers, customs brokers, and transportation partners, ideally in manufacturing, recycling, or industrial sectors.
li
Ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously, with strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
li
Comfort with using ERP or supply chain systems, and basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
li
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to address delays, regulatory changes, and operational issues proactively.
li
Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred.
li
Prior experience in on-site roles and familiarity with safety standards and procedures in industrial environments is an advantage.
li
Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural environment and commitment to sustainable and ethical business practices.
